description: Defines a Flutter widget for a Reset Button used in a Tic Tac Toe game interface. The widget adapts its label and style based on game state, supporting user interaction to reset or start a new game.

classes.name: ResetButton
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a reset or play again button with adaptive styling depending on game over state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including animated transitions and styling, based on whether the game is over.
